decisions.statement: The name one system has is not the name a second system has.
`libc.so.6` names no library of any kind where musl runs.
`dlopen` reached through an object is refused as a bare call is.
A library is named by the last part of its path.
Only the C runtime family is named.
Opening a library in general is an ordinary thing to do.
A name built as the code runs is not seen.
A name written where the library is opened is seen.

definition: the rule refusing a core system library opened by name rather than the one already mapped
